scenarios.expected: Assignment persists without deciding the Request or reserving it. Dispositioned Requests leave the undecided Inbox and retain their outcome. Resolve requires an explanatory Full Thread note; Decline is absent from the current Triage menu. A concurrent disposition produces a clear lost-race result rather than a second outcome.
scenarios.actual: Daniel Okafor opened the Inbox on Status: New ordered by urgency then age, opened R-108, read Description, Form responses, Attachments, Converts to, Requester and Urgency, and downloaded the original PDF byte-for-byte. Assign from the list row, reassignment from the avatar, Cancel, and Unassigned behaved as the guide says; the other legal session kept Triage and the status stayed New; a people-load failure offered Retry, a failed save kept the prior assignment, and the retry saved. A Full thread clarification reached Jonas Weber while a Legal only note did not, and the Request stayed New. Triage offered Convert to contract, Convert to matter and Resolve request without converting, with no Decline. A blank resolution note was refused and Cancel changed nothing; resolving R-129 with a note showed Outcome Resolved, the note in Comments and on the Portal, the assignee retained read-only, Jonas's reply without reopening, and a resolution email. Removing the Status filter listed the resolved Request; Status Declined listed historical R-77 with its reason and no Assign or Triage controls. A competing resolution on R-110 by the other session left the dialog stating the outcome with Close and only the winning note posted. Ravi Menon and Jonas Weber could not open the Inbox.
